svg.text: >_ i design it, build it, and ship it myself
>_ no handoff. the interface is the deliverable, not the file

g.text: Execution: builds the page end to end.
Direction: sets the plan before anything ships.
Judgment: stress-tests the work before it goes live.
Intel: researches patterns and precedent first.
Voice: writes copy that sounds like Sara, not a template.
Say hi ▸ I like talking about design that ships.
